Ali Fazal to star in BBC-CBC adaptation of 'A Passage to India'

Actor Ali Fazal will headline a new five-part adaptation of E.M. Forster's novel 'A Passage to India' for the BBC and CBC. Emmy-winning director Richie Mehta is attached to the project. The cast also includes Naseeruddin Shah and Fiona Shaw.
